exact.✔ 正確！M-P 等權固定，感知機可調有偏見。: ✔ Correct! M-P has fixed, equal weights; the perceptron's weights are tunable and it has a bias.
exact.✔ 正確！線性分類器一條直線切不開對角四角。: ✔ Correct! A linear classifier's single straight line can't separate the diagonal corners of the square.
exact.✔ 正確！感知機錯才調（離散），ADALINE 一直用 LMS 梯度。: ✔ Correct! The perceptron only adjusts when it's wrong (discrete updates); ADALINE keeps adjusting with the LMS gradient.
exact.✔ 正確！−0.1 < 0 故輸出 0 錯。: ✔ Correct! −0.1 < 0, so the output is 0, which is wrong.
exact.✗ 再想想：誰的權重可調？: ✗ Think again: whose weights are tunable?
exact.✗ 提示：幾何上直線能否切開 XOR？: ✗ Hint: geometrically, can a straight line separate XOR?
exact.✗ 提示：離散更新 vs 梯度下降。: ✗ Hint: discrete updates vs. gradient descent.
exact.✗ 提示：總分加上偏置後，與 0 比較。: ✗ Hint: add the bias to the total score, then compare it with 0.

8cb914fea29c.zh:
AI 考古時光機
從數學神經到冰河期
8cb914fea29c.en:
AI Archaeology Time Machine
From the Mathematical Neuron to the Winter

b60d0615d259.zh: 1943 一根神經，1949 一句口訣，1958 一台胚胎，1969 一盆冷水 One neuron, one motto, one embryo, one winter — the first arc of deep learning.
b60d0615d259.en: 1943, one neuron; 1949, one motto; 1958, one embryo; 1969, one bucket of cold water

afc490816a6e.zh: ▾ SCROLL TO EXPLORE · 長頁自學模式
afc490816a6e.en: ▾ SCROLL TO EXPLORE · Long-Page Self-Study Mode

9c6beffd7028.zh:
為何 1958 年的「電子胚胎」
會在 1969 年被一條直線凍結？Why did the 1958 “electronic embryo” freeze on a straight line in 1969?
9c6beffd7028.en:
Why did the 1958 “electronic embryo”
get frozen by a single straight line in 1969?

b1b80d4f204e.zh: 答案不在程式碼，在幾何：直線能切 AND，卻切不開 XOR。Not code but geometry: a line cuts AND, not XOR.
b1b80d4f204e.en: The answer is not in the code but in the geometry: a straight line can cut AND, yet it cannot split XOR apart.

df214ff3810a.zh: 一句話史：數學神經 → 自己變聰明 → 教會一群神經 One-Liner History
df214ff3810a.en: One-Liner History: A Mathematical Neuron → Getting Smarter on Its Own → Teaching a Whole Group of Neurons

0464b17fcdfd.zh: 先用數學做神經（M-P），再想讓它自己變強（Hebb），終於教會一顆神經自己調權重（Perceptron/ADALINE），卻卡在「教會一群」。First math neuron, then self-strengthening, then self-tuning — stuck at teaching a group.
0464b17fcdfd.en: First, build a neuron out of math (M-P); next, try to make it get stronger by itself (Hebb); at last, teach a single neuron to tune its own weights (Perceptron/ADALINE), only to get stuck at “teaching a whole group”.

a14661cdff0f.zh: 加法＋門檻，權重固定相等，輸出 0/1；足夠多即可做 AND/OR/NOT。Sum + threshold, fixed equal weights, 0/1.
a14661cdff0f.en: Addition + a threshold, weights fixed and equal, output 0/1; with enough of them you can build AND/OR/NOT.

b54cbcf37ed2.zh: Hebb 學習 Fire Together, Wire Together

360be30f9331.zh: 一起放電→連結變強；獎勵為 1 的輸入，雛形學習。Co-fire → strengthen.
360be30f9331.en: Fire together → the connection gets stronger; reward the inputs that are 1, an embryonic form of learning.

dff6959658e0.zh: 權重可調：Perceptron 錯了才調，ADALINE 以梯度下降追求誤差最小。Tunable weights; error-driven vs gradient.
dff6959658e0.en: Tunable weights: the Perceptron adjusts only when it gets something wrong, while ADALINE uses gradient descent to minimize the error.

bfd838b305c6.zh: 單層線性不可解 XOR；多層在理論上可解卻無訓練演算法，直到 Backprop。Linear cannot do XOR; multi-layer lacked algorithm.
bfd838b305c6.en: A single linear layer cannot solve XOR; multiple layers could solve it in theory, but there was no training algorithm for them until backprop.

b28541aa9c27.zh: 直覺 · 法拉利與輪子
b28541aa9c27.en: Intuition · The Ferrari and the Wheel

2bfd5c3d29b2.zh: 會開法拉利前先懂輪子：M-P 是輪子，Hebb 是「獎勵好輪子」的想法，Perceptron 是會自己換輪子的車。Before Ferrari, understand wheel: M-P is wheel, Hebb is “reward good wheels”, Perceptron swaps wheels itself.
2bfd5c3d29b2.en: Before you can drive a Ferrari, understand the wheel: M-P is the wheel, Hebb is the idea of “rewarding good wheels”, and the Perceptron is a car that changes its own wheels.

74ec776abc4d.zh: S2 · 第一根神經 · FIRST NEURON

969b03465ef2.zh: 1 · M-P 模型（1943）：史上第一根數學神經 M-P Model — Mathematical Neuron
969b03465ef2.en: 1 · The M-P Model (1943): The First Mathematical Neuron in History

096cabf98dc3.zh: 真空管如房間大的年代，McCulloch（神經生理）與 Pitts（邏輯）把神經簡化為「有原則的傳聲筒」：等權相加→門檻比較→0/1。Vacuum-tube era: sum equally → threshold → 0/1.
096cabf98dc3.en: Back when vacuum tubes were the size of a room, McCulloch (neurophysiology) and Pitts (logic) simplified the neuron into a “principled megaphone”: add up with equal weights → compare against a threshold → 0/1.

7012c9b74669.zh: M-P 數學神經：等權相加，與門檻比較，輸出 0/1 · Hebb 口訣：Cells that fire together, wire together.
7012c9b74669.en: M-P mathematical neuron: add up with equal weights, compare against a threshold, output 0/1 · Hebb's motto: Cells that fire together, wire together.

4b3461362438.zh: 為何重要 · Why It Matters

76614819c6aa.zh: 證明足夠多這類單元可實現 AND / OR / NOT → 具通用邏輯能力，為網路奠基。Enough units → universal logic (AND/OR/NOT).
76614819c6aa.en: It proved that enough units of this kind can implement AND / OR / NOT → universal logic capability, laying the foundation for networks.

332a655b4525.zh: 所有輸入等重，一視同仁；超過門檻就大叫 1，否則 0——最純的二元決策。Equal weights; fire if sum > threshold.
332a655b4525.en: Every input weighs the same and is treated equally; if the total exceeds the threshold it shouts 1, otherwise 0: the purest binary decision.

bd7afaa0e771.zh: 權重固定、需手設門檻，不會學習；等待 Hebb 與 Rosenblatt 解放。Fixed weights, no learning.
bd7afaa0e771.en: Fixed weights, a hand-set threshold, and no learning; it had to wait for Hebb and Rosenblatt to set it free.

736858a98dee.zh: 示意：$n$ 個 0/1 輸入等權相加，與閾值 $\theta$ 比較；多單元互連可表任意邏輯。Equal-weight sum vs threshold; networked → any logic.
736858a98dee.en: Sketch: $n$ inputs of 0/1 are added with equal weights and compared with the threshold $\theta$; interconnecting many units can represent any logic.

73a2446452e9.zh: S2 · 棍棒與糖果 · LEARNING IDEA

57fe892fe0cf.zh: 2 · Hebb 學習（1949）：一起放電，一起變強 Hebbian Learning
57fe892fe0cf.en: 2 · Hebbian learning (1949): fire together, wire together

9d222dbeae73.zh: Donald Hebb 一句話開啟學習時代：常一起出現的輸入與答案，其連結變強；不再手調。Co-occurrence → stronger wire; no hand-tuning.
9d222dbeae73.en: With a single sentence, Donald Hebb opened the era of learning: when an input and the answer often show up together, the connection between them gets stronger; no more hand-tuning.

460201d9476c.zh: Δw ∝ x · y  （共放電則加強）

ad99dd80ba2a.zh: 為 1 的輸入與正確答案一起→權重調大
ad99dd80ba2a.en: Input of 1 together with the right answer → weight up

cd1330a20f80.zh: Hebb 雛形：獎勵常與正解共現的輸入，連結變強 · Reward co-firing.
cd1330a20f80.en: Hebbian prototype: inputs that often co-occur with the correct answer are rewarded, and their connections grow stronger

b57fa8c5588c.zh: 「一起放電，一起變強」——從手調到自學的哲學轉折。From hand-tuned to self-tuning philosophy.
b57fa8c5588c.en: “Fire together, wire together”: the philosophical turn from hand-tuning to self-learning.

812cace8bb89.zh: 常與正解一起的輸入吃糖（$w$ 調大），否則棍棒；Perceptron 與 ADALINE 皆受此啟發。Co-fire → candy (up-weight).
812cace8bb89.en: Inputs that often show up with the correct answer get candy ($w$ goes up); otherwise they get the stick. Both the Perceptron and ADALINE were inspired by this.

5ec1527773e4.zh: Hebb 給方向，未給可收斂的數學規則；Rosenblatt 與 Widrow 才把它變成演算法。Idea, not yet algorithm.
5ec1527773e4.en: Hebb gave a direction, but not a mathematical rule that converges; it took Rosenblatt and Widrow to turn it into an algorithm.

517f77198aac.zh: 公式 · Hebb 更新雛形

bd43da5e4a57.zh: 共放電（$x_j$ 與 $y$ 同為 1）則加強；為後續有監督調整埋下伏筆。Co-fire → strengthen; precursor to supervised correction.
bd43da5e4a57.en: When they fire together ($x_j$ and $y$ are both 1), the connection is strengthened; this lays the groundwork for the supervised adjustment that came later.

0d93f73f60d5.zh: 3 · Perceptron（1958）：終於有偏見、會自己學 Perceptron — Biased & Self-Tuning
0d93f73f60d5.en: 3 · Perceptron (1958): finally biased, and learning on its own

ca0689781020.zh: 與 M-P 最大不同：每輸入有權重 $w_j$ 表示重要性；錯了才調，調錯的。Per-input weight $w_j$ = importance; correct only when wrong.
ca0689781020.en: The biggest difference from M-P: each input has a weight $w_j$ that represents its importance; it adjusts only when it is wrong, and it adjusts what went wrong.

e4103c8d28e1.zh: 對了不調，錯了才調（有監督）

4f26b4a39d37.zh: Rosenblatt：電子胚胎將能看說寫 · embryo will see/speak/write
4f26b4a39d37.en: Rosenblatt: the electronic embryo will see, speak, write

66659977f286.zh: 權重可調、有偏見；有監督錯了才調 · Tunable biased; supervised correction on error.
66659977f286.en: Tunable weights and a bias of its own; supervised, adjusting only when wrong

c7d63a6fa7be.en: Having a bias is the whole point

0a6c06978c7f.zh: $w_j$ 代表重要性：紅色重要則 $w_1$ 大，圓形次要則 $w_2$ 小——模型終於有主見。$w_j$ = importance; model gains opinion.
0a6c06978c7f.en: $w_j$ represents importance: if red matters, $w_1$ is large; if roundness is secondary, $w_2$ is small. The model finally has opinions of its own.

f5b46cff032e.zh: 能自學認數字，記者驚呼將能走說看寫有意識——可惜被一條直線打臉。Self-learn digits → hype → hit by a line.
f5b46cff032e.en: It could teach itself to recognize digits, and reporters gasped that it would walk, talk, see, write, and be conscious. Too bad it got slapped down by a straight line.

945da63f8e92.zh: $w_j \leftarrow w_j + \eta x_j (y-\hat y)$，$b \leftarrow b + \eta(y-\hat y)$；該 1 猜 0 時，同時提高為 1 的輸入權重與偏置。Reward active inputs and raise the bias on an error.
945da63f8e92.en: $w_j \leftarrow w_j + \eta x_j (y-\hat y)$, $b \leftarrow b + \eta(y-\hat y)$; when the answer should be 1 but it guesses 0, it raises the weights of the inputs that are 1 and the bias at the same time.

9e3eaa63594e.zh: 公式 · 感知機決策與學習

5952ea262d12.zh: 有監督、離散更新（非梯度），幾何上為移動直線。Supervised, discrete correction; moves the line.
5952ea262d12.en: Supervised, discrete updates (not gradient-based); geometrically, each update moves a straight line.

a42192cb6701.zh: 感知機計算：遙認紅蘋果 Perceptron in Action — Red Apple?
a42192cb6701.en: Perceptron calculation: recognizing a red apple

130a150dcd72.zh: 兩特徵 $x_1$紅/$x_2$圓、AND 邏輯（紅 AND 圓才 1）、$\eta=0.1$、初始 $w=(0.1,0.3), b=-0.5$。Two features, AND logic, $\eta=0.1$, init $w=(0.1,0.3), b=-0.5$.
130a150dcd72.en: Two features, $x_1$ red / $x_2$ round; AND logic (output 1 only if red AND round); $\eta=0.1$; initial $w=(0.1,0.3), b=-0.5$.

ece94bea6760.en: Red apple AND, step by step

fac338ede2a6.zh: Rosenblatt 更新（該 1 猜 0→獎為 1 的輸入）

49b605e5e4ec.zh: 結果：更喜歡紅色，更易啟動
49b605e5e4ec.en: Result: likes red more, fires more easily

6aa9a12a8669.zh: 該 1 猜 0→給為 1 的輸入加糖，偏置提高 · Reward co-firing, raise bias.
6aa9a12a8669.en: Should be 1 but guessed 0 → give candy to the inputs that are 1 and raise the bias

4fd5012c53ce.zh: 猜太小（該 1 猜 0）→讓為 1 的 $x_j$ 加分，並提高偏置 $b$。下次同樣蘋果更容易說 1。Under-predict → boost active $x_j$ and raise bias $b$.
4fd5012c53ce.en: Guessed too low (should be 1, guessed 0) → add points to each $x_j$ that is 1, and raise the bias $b$. Next time, the same apple is more likely to get a 1.

51ea917e9ed4.zh: 一次就讓 $w_1$ 0.1→0.2，模型學會偏愛紅色——經驗累積為偏見。One step: $w_1$ 0.1→0.2 — experience becomes bias.
51ea917e9ed4.en: A single step takes $w_1$ from 0.1 to 0.2, and the model learns to favor red: accumulated experience becomes bias.

e31355527219.en: But in the end it must face the straight line

092154c9c234.zh: 更新本質是移動切割直線；能切 AND，卻永不能切 XOR。Update moves the line — cuts AND, never XOR.
092154c9c234.en: At heart, an update just moves the cutting line; it can cut AND, but it can never cut XOR.

0508a59e5435.zh: 本例：$y-\hat y=1$，$x=(1,1)$，$\eta=0.1$ → $\Delta w=(0.1,0.1)$, $\Delta b=+0.1$。Error 1, $x=(1,1)$ → $\Delta w=(0.1,0.1)$ and $\Delta b=+0.1$.
0508a59e5435.en: In this example: $y-\hat y=1$, $x=(1,1)$, $\eta=0.1$ → $\Delta w=(0.1,0.1)$, $\Delta b=+0.1$.

66a95495fa17.zh: 互動：拉動 $\eta$ 看更新幅度 · Drag $\eta$ to see step size
66a95495fa17.en: Interactive: drag $\eta$ to see the update size

032c508b2ca7.zh: 冰河期：一條直線凍結浪潮 Winter — A Line Freezes the Wave
032c508b2ca7.en: Ice age: one straight line freezes the wave

f404dd36d891.zh: 感知機是線性分類器：一刀切。AND 可切，XOR 不可切。Minsky & Papert 1969 以嚴謹證明澆熄樂觀。Linear classifier: one cut. AND yes, XOR no. 1969 proof killed hype.
f404dd36d891.en: The perceptron is a linear classifier: one cut. AND can be cut; XOR cannot. In 1969, Minsky & Papert doused the optimism with a rigorous proof.

8e1e2b98ad4b.zh: matplotlib 精準：線性可分 vs 非線性 · AND vs XOR geometry
8e1e2b98ad4b.en: Precise matplotlib plot: linearly separable vs. nonlinear (AND vs. XOR geometry)

8b914900d8b8.zh: 左 AND：$x_1+x_2=1.5$ 一刀切開；右 XOR：任何直線均失敗 · Left: line cuts AND; right: no line cuts XOR.
8b914900d8b8.en: Left, AND: the line $x_1+x_2=1.5$ separates it in one cut; right, XOR: every straight line fails

4a22c1f7c4bb.zh: 為何 XOR 殺死單層
4a22c1f7c4bb.en: Why XOR kills the single layer

3502d9fbb3e9.zh: 四角點對角同類：$(0,0)/(1,1)$ 一類，$(0,1)/(1,0)$ 另一類——沒直線可分。Corners diagonal same class — no line.
3502d9fbb3e9.en: Diagonally opposite corners share a class: $(0,0)/(1,1)$ are one class and $(0,1)/(1,0)$ the other, so no straight line can separate them.

f1570da6de4c.zh: 多層理論可解，卻無法教
f1570da6de4c.en: Multiple layers could solve it in theory, but could not be taught

e9995141998a.zh: Rosenblatt 書《Principles of Neurodynamics》嘗試鬆散串聯，但差正確時不知調哪層——直到 Backprop。Multi-layer could in theory, but no training rule until Backprop.
e9995141998a.en: In his book “Principles of Neurodynamics,” Rosenblatt tried loosely chaining layers together, but when the output differed from the correct answer, nobody knew which layer to adjust, until backprop came along.

078e4af4b908.zh: 《Perceptrons》一書凍結十年；需要新數學才能教會一群神經。Book froze a decade; needed new math to teach a crowd.
078e4af4b908.en: The book “Perceptrons” froze the field for a decade; new math was needed to teach a whole crowd of neurons.

ff90eff69e70.zh: S2 · 更穩的學 · STABLE LEARNING

3290e1688e29.zh: 5 · ADALINE / MADALINE（1960）：梯度下降學更穩 ADALINE — Gradient Descent Learns Steadier
3290e1688e29.en: 5 · ADALINE / MADALINE (1960): gradient descent learns more steadily

7cfd6b3108bc.zh: 感知機「對不調錯才調」，ADALINE「追求完美」——看總分與正確的均方誤差，用梯度下降持續微調。Perceptron tunes on error; ADALINE chases LMS via gradient descent, always tuning.
7cfd6b3108bc.en: The perceptron “leaves it alone when it is right and adjusts only when it is wrong”; ADALINE “strives for perfection”: it looks at the mean squared error between the total score and the correct answer, and keeps fine-tuning with gradient descent.

1937e12293f5.zh: matplotlib 精準：左 MSE 地形 + 梯度路徑至 w* · 右離散調整 vs 持續 LMS · Precise terrain & discrete vs continuous.
1937e12293f5.en: Precise matplotlib plots: left, the MSE landscape and the gradient path to w*; right, discrete adjustment vs. continuous LMS

b3fc1e205783.zh: 不看 0/1、看總分誤差。沿負梯度走，追求均方誤差最小。Not 0/1 but score error; follow negative gradient.
b3fc1e205783.en: It doesn't look at 0/1; it looks at the error in the total score. It walks along the negative gradient, seeking the smallest mean squared error.

9da0c7db6475.zh: 數學更穩、泛化更好，但本質仍線性——也被冰河凍住。More robust, better generalization, still linear.
9da0c7db6475.en: Mathematically more stable and better at generalization, but still linear at heart, so it too was frozen by the ice age.

24b787851cbe.zh: 疊 Many ADALINEs，MR III 換 Sigmoid 可導函數才能算梯度教多層，卻未形成系統理論直到 Backprop。MR III used sigmoid to allow gradients for multi-layer.
24b787851cbe.en: Stack Many ADALINEs; MR III switched to the differentiable sigmoid function so that gradients could be computed to train multiple layers, yet no systematic theory took shape until backprop.

d7e741982048.zh: $\hat s=\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}$ 為總分（未閾值），每步沿負梯度下降。$\hat s$ is pre-threshold score; step along negative gradient.
d7e741982048.en: $\hat s=\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}$ is the total score (before thresholding); each step descends along the negative gradient.

a542aee1578b.zh: 三波神經網路簡表 Three Generations
a542aee1578b.en: The Three Waves of Neural Networks at a Glance

be385e2ee51d.zh: 無法解 XOR；啟動從例子中學習
be385e2ee51d.en: Cannot solve XOR; launched learning from examples

b6999548af2e.zh: 利用放電時間差，未來方向
b6999548af2e.en: Exploits differences in spike timing; a future direction

af5c143bc540.zh: 先做出神經（M-P）→想讓它自強（Hebb）→教會一顆自學（Perceptron/ADALINE）→卡在教會一群（直到 Backprop）。Neuron → self-strengthen → one learns → group stuck until Backprop.
af5c143bc540.en: First build a neuron (M-P) → want it to strengthen itself (Hebb) → teach one neuron to learn on its own (Perceptron/ADALINE) → get stuck teaching a whole group (until backprop).

3eecbd91541f.zh: 1980 年代，科學家終於找到教一群神經的神奇演算法——反向傳播。1980s: finally the algorithm to teach a crowd — Backprop.
3eecbd91541f.en: In the 1980s, scientists finally found the magic algorithm for teaching a whole group of neurons: backpropagation.

8fb62bf6321e.zh: 深入：邏輯閘、演算法與冰河的連動 Deeper — Logic, Algorithm & Winter
8fb62bf6321e.en: Going Deeper: How Logic Gates, Algorithms, and the Winter Connect

c7dd09b3c33f.en: Tunable w, adjust only on error

5d611b05e770.zh: ADALINE 1960 梯度下降更穩、MADALINE 直到 Sigmoid 才可導 → Backprop 才終結冰河
5d611b05e770.en: ADALINE (1960): gradient descent, more stable; MADALINE not differentiable until sigmoid → only backprop ends the winter

9d3369db283c.zh: 四站時光機：數學神經→自強→自學→凍結（線性終數） · Four stops: neuron → strengthen → learn → freeze.
9d3369db283c.en: A four-stop time machine: mathematical neuron → self-strengthening → self-learning → frozen (the linear limit).

196412252011.zh: M-P 給了邏輯通用性，Hebb 給了學習哲學，Perceptron 把哲學變演算法，ADALINE 用梯度更穩——但線性終數讓重點在「教會一群」。M-P gave logic, Hebb gave philosophy, Perceptron made algorithm, ADALINE stabilized — but linear caps at teaching a crowd.
196412252011.en: M-P gave logical universality, Hebb gave a philosophy of learning, the perceptron turned that philosophy into an algorithm, and ADALINE made it more stable with gradients. But the linear limit shifted the focus to “teaching a whole group.”

013019224e7f.zh: 思考測驗：你懂線性終數嗎？ Quiz — Do You Get Linear Limit?

b099c518abbe.zh: M-P 會自學，感知機不會M-P learns
b099c518abbe.en: M-P learns on its own; the perceptron does not

0b56a62b1b4e.en: M-P weights are fixed and equal; perceptron weights are tunable and it has a bias

3456ca7828b7.en: Q2. Why can't a single-layer perceptron solve XOR?

fc560a007247.zh: 因為是線性分類器，一條直線切不開對角同類四角Linear: no line cuts diagonal
fc560a007247.en: Because it is a linear classifier: no single straight line can separate four corners where the diagonally opposite ones share a class

f19e5254314b.zh: 因為沒有 SigmoidNo sigmoid

036e0d6fb7a0.zh: 因為 Hebb 口訣錯誤Hebb wrong

a4c1d213d184.zh: 因為學習率太小Learning rate small

f7a0c09198b4.zh: 都是梯度下降Both gradient

156f90e175b3.zh: Perceptron 用梯度，ADALINE 錯才調Swapped
156f90e175b3.en: The perceptron uses gradients; ADALINE adjusts only on errors

60b523b94890.zh: Perceptron 錯才調；ADALINE 看總分誤差用梯度一直微調Error-only vs always LMS
60b523b94890.en: The perceptron adjusts only on errors; ADALINE looks at the error in the total score and keeps fine-tuning with gradients

e5f35db2d32e.zh: ADALINE 不能疊 SigmoidADALINE no sigmoid
e5f35db2d32e.en: ADALINE cannot have a sigmoid stacked on it
